en_title: FromSoftware's Bloodborne Is Still Selling Hundreds of Thousands of Copies, Over a Decade After Launch
cn_title: From Software的《血源诅咒》发售十余年后，仍在卖出数十万份
opus_summary: 据Alinea Analytics估算，《血源诅咒》今年已售出超过25.1万份，自2015年3月发售以来累计销量约1040万份。分析师Rhys Elliott称，该游戏创造了约3.17亿美元(约合人民币21亿元)收入；估计10月另有约50万人通过PS Plus游玩。

paragraphs.en: All FromSoftware games rule, but Bloodborne has the coolest vibes. You’re dripping in Victorian garb, flanked by gothic architecture, and stalked by Lovecraftian terrors across cobbled streets that run red with each sword swing, wielding weapons that shift and transform mid-combo, parrying with a shotgun — it’s just sick. Perhaps it shouldn't come as a surprise, then, that it's still selling hundreds of thousands of copies a year despite being over a decade old.
paragraphs.cn: From Software的游戏都很棒，但《血源诅咒》的氛围最酷。你身着华丽的维多利亚时代服饰，两侧是哥特式建筑，洛夫克拉夫特式的恐怖之物在鹅卵石街道上尾随你，每次挥剑都会让街道染红；你挥舞着能在连招中变形转换的武器，用霰弹枪招架——简直酷毙了。因此，尽管它已经推出十多年，每年仍能卖出数十万份，或许也不该令人意外。

paragraphs.en: According to Alinea Analytics estimates, the PS4 exclusive has reportedly sold more than 251,000 copies this year alone. Analyst Rhys Elliott took to social media to note that the game has sold to an estimated 10.4 million copies since going on sale in March 2015, generating around $317 million in revenue.
paragraphs.cn: 据Alinea Analytics估算，这款PS4独占游戏仅在今年就售出了超过251,000份。分析师Rhys Elliott在社交媒体上指出，这款游戏自2015年3月发售以来，估计已售出1,040万份，创造了约3.17亿美元的收入。

paragraphs.en: On top of the impressive sales, an estimated half a million played Bloodborne in October through PS Plus, Sony’s video game subscription service. Bloodborne continues to be hugely popular among fans of FromSoftware games, the data suggests. Of those nearly 500,000 players, 12% also played Elden Ring this month, while 6% also played Dark Souls 3 and 5% also played Sekiro. “There’s a cohort of gamers who are always bouncing between different From games. Can’t blame them, especially with this one," Elliott said.
paragraphs.cn: 除了亮眼的销量，据估计，10月还有50万人通过索尼的电子游戏订阅服务PS Plus游玩了《血源诅咒》。数据显示，《血源诅咒》在From Software游戏的粉丝中依然大受欢迎。在这近500,000名玩家中，12%的人本月还玩了《艾尔登法环》，6%的人还玩了《黑暗之魂3》，5%的人还玩了《Sekiro》。Elliott说：「有一群玩家总是在不同的From游戏之间切换。这也不能怪他们，尤其是有这款游戏在。」

paragraphs.en: Bloodborne is one of the few PS4 exclusives that never got a PS5 update and is still (officially at least) locked at 30fps, despite public demand for a Bloodborne remaster. Modders have managed to get Bloodborne running at 120fps on higher resolutions than previously possible on PS5 , however.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管公众呼吁推出《血源诅咒》复刻版，但《血源诅咒》是少数从未获得PS5更新的PS4独占游戏之一，至今仍锁定在30fps（至少官方版本如此）。不过，模组制作者已经设法让《血源诅咒》在PS5上以120fps运行，分辨率也高于此前所能达到的水平。

paragraphs.en: The now-shuttered Bluepoint , the studio behind the successful Shadow of the Colossus and Demon's Souls remakes, reportedly pitched a Bloodborne remake last year that was rejected not by Sony, as many had thought, but by FromSoftware itself.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，如今已关闭的Bluepoint工作室去年曾提出制作《血源诅咒》重制版的方案，但拒绝这一方案的并非许多人所认为的索尼，而是From Software自己。Bluepoint是成功重制《旺达与巨像》和《恶魔之魂》的工作室。

paragraphs.en: Then, the following year, PlayStation's Shuhei Yoshida offered a theory on KindaFunny as to what was going on with Bloodborne that might have matched up with what happened to Bluepoint's pitch: "Bloodborne has always been the most asked thing. And people wonder why we haven’t really done anything, even an update or a remaster. Should be easy, right? The company is known for doing so many remasters, right, some people get frustrated.
paragraphs.cn: 到了次年，PlayStation的吉田修平在KindaFunny上就《血源诅咒》的情况提出了一个猜测，可能与Bluepoint方案的遭遇相吻合：「《血源诅咒》一直是被问得最多的话题。人们想知道为什么我们实际上什么都没做，甚至连更新或复刻版都没有。应该很容易才对吧？这家公司以制作了这么多复刻版而闻名，对吧？有些人对此感到沮丧。

paragraphs.en: "I have only my personal theory to that situation. I left first-party so I don’t know what’s going on, but my theory is, you know because I remember, you know, Miyazaki-san really, really loved Bloodborne, you know, what he created. So I think he is interested, but he’s so successful and he’s so busy, so he doesn’t want, he cannot do himself, but he does not want anyone else to touch it. So that’s my theory. And the PlayStation team respect his wish. So that’s my guess, right? Theory. I am not revealing any secret information, to be clear."
paragraphs.cn: 「关于那个情况，我只有自己的猜测。我离开了第一方团队，所以不知道发生了什么，但我的猜测是，你知道，因为我记得，你知道，宫崎先生真的、真的很喜欢《血源诅咒》，你知道，他创造的作品。所以我认为他有兴趣，但他非常成功，也非常忙，所以他不想——他自己没法做，但他不想让其他任何人碰它。这就是我的猜测。而PlayStation团队尊重他的意愿。所以这只是我的猜想，对吧？猜测。说清楚一点，我没有透露任何秘密信息。」

paragraphs.en: There are some signs of life, though. Sony announced an R-rated animated Bloodborne movie earlier this year, produced by YouTuber JackSepticEye.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，还是有一些动静的。索尼今年早些时候宣布了一部R级《血源诅咒》动画电影，由油管主JackSepticEye担任制片人。

paragraphs.en: As for FromSoftware itself, it's gearing up to launch the recently delayed Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive, The Duskbloods , next year. Its most recent game is co-op spinoff Elden Ring: Nightreign . Miyazaki recently reassured fans that the developer is still focused on single-player games. In December 2024, Miyazaki said FromSoftware was not considering making Elden Ring 2 , but wouldn't shut down the possibility in the future. If not, there is an Elden Ring movie in the works.
paragraphs.cn: 至于From Software本身，它正准备于明年推出最近延期的Switch 2独占游戏《The Duskbloods》。它最近推出的游戏是合作衍生作《艾尔登法环：黑夜君临》。宫崎最近向粉丝保证，这家开发商仍然专注于单人游戏。2024年12月，宫崎表示From Software没有考虑制作《艾尔登法环2》，但不会排除未来制作的可能性。即便没有续作，一部《艾尔登法环》电影也正在制作中。
